description: This is a PHP source file defining the IDGeneratorService class within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for generating unique identifiers for various entities such as Location, JobCategory, JobTitle, Membership, and Employee, managing auto-increment IDs, and prefixing based on entity type.

classes.name: IDGeneratorService
classes.description: Service class responsible for generating and managing unique IDs for various entities in OrangeHRM, including prefix handling and ID incrementation.

methods.name: getIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Lazy initialization getter for the IDGeneratorDao instance.

methods.name: setIDGeneratorDao
methods.description: Setter method for injecting a custom IDGeneratorDao instance.

methods.name: getEntityPrefix
methods.description: Determines the prefix string based on the entity class type.

methods.name: getNextID
methods.description: Generates the next unique ID for the specified entity, optionally updating the stored current ID.

methods.name: incrementId
methods.description: Increments the current ID for the specified entity class.
